excerpts.section: ERC 2025 First Aid, Concise guidelines for clinical practice, Hypoglycaemia (low blood sugar value)
excerpts.text: Suspect hypoglycaemia in someone with diabetes or chronic malnutrition AND sudden impaired responsiveness or behavioural change.

excerpts.section: ERC 2025 First Aid, Concise guidelines for clinical practice, Hypoglycaemia (low blood sugar value)
excerpts.text: by mouth if the person is awake and able to swallow.

excerpts.section: ERC 2025 First Aid, Concise guidelines for clinical practice, Hypoglycaemia (low blood sugar value), unresponsive persons
excerpts.text: For unresponsive persons, do not give oral sugar due to the risk of aspiration, instead call your local emergency number (112).

excerpts.section: ERC 2025 First Aid, Concise guidelines for clinical practice, Hypoglycaemia (low blood sugar value), after recovery
excerpts.text: Following recovery from symptoms (5–10 min after sugar intake) encourage the person to eat a light snack.
